The method: Obtain lock by Read. Following are all s/w operation possibilities: When reading '1' - lock is obtained. (i.e. no debugss request was active during the rd transaction). When reading '0' - lock is not obtained. Try to read again. (i.e. at least debugss request event was active during the rd transaction). when writing '1' - lock will be obtained regardless to debugss request status when writing '0' - lock will be released.
